story.label: What I studied
story.text: **Banking and Financial Services** at the **University of Dar es Salaam**, from 2022 to 2025. Along the way I interned at **Tanzania Commercial Bank**, at the front office and the teller desk.

story.label: What I do now
story.text: At **Exxonim Company Limited** I build **websites, Android apps and internal systems**. I also work on the business side: budgets, accounting records, reporting and audit support. In 2026 I also cleaned the **Tanzania Red Cross Society**’s data on contract and moved it into their new database and system.

story.label: What I’m learning
story.text: **New technologies**, all the time. I read about **technology and business**, and I write about them on this site.

story.label: What I’m looking for
story.text: A new role or a freelance project in **software, finance or business operations**.

story.label: Nilichosoma
story.text: **Benki na Huduma za Fedha** katika **Chuo Kikuu cha Dar es Salaam**, kuanzia 2022 hadi 2025. Katikati ya masomo nilifanya mafunzo kwa vitendo katika **Tanzania Commercial Bank**, kwenye dawati la mbele na kaunta.

story.label: Ninachofanya sasa
story.text: Katika **Exxonim Company Limited** ninatengeneza **tovuti, programu za Android na mifumo ya ndani**. Pia ninafanya kazi upande wa biashara: bajeti, kumbukumbu za uhasibu, ripoti na msaada wa ukaguzi. Mwaka 2026 pia nilisafisha data ya **Chama cha Msalaba Mwekundu Tanzania** kwa mkataba, na kuihamishia kwenye hifadhidata na mfumo wao mpya.

story.label: Ninachojifunza
story.text: **Teknolojia mpya**, kila wakati. Ninasoma kuhusu **teknolojia na biashara**, na ninaandika kuzihusu kwenye tovuti hii.

story.label: Ninachotafuta
story.text: Ajira mpya au mradi binafsi katika **teknolojia, fedha au uendeshaji wa biashara**.

story.label: Nje ya kazi
story.text: Ninapenda **kazi za hisani na kusaidia watu**.
